name: Savage Schematics
text: I've heard tales of a tribal design called Savage Fury. It's crude but surprisingly effective for early combat. If you can find the Savage Schematics, I can decipher them and craft the entire set for you.
completionText: These schematics are rough, but the design is sound. Give me a moment... yes, here is your Savage Fury armor. Wear it well.

name: Trackers Schematics
text: Hunters and rangers often rely on the Tracker's Guise. It's light, durable, and perfect for moving silently. Bring me the Trackers Schematics, and I'll make the set yours.
completionText: Ah, the Tracker's Guise. Excellent stitching on these plans. Here is the set, crafted exactly to specification.

name: Steel Schematics
text: For heavy protection, nothing beats the Steel Vanguard. It's bulky but it'll save your life in a pinch. Find the Steel Schematics, and I'll forge it for you.
completionText: Heavy, solid steel. Just the way it should be. The Vanguard set is ready for battle.

name: Wizard Schematics
text: Magic users need specialized gear. The Wizard's Regalia is threaded with silver runes to ward off elemental damage. Bring me the Wizard Schematics, and I'll weave it for you.
completionText: Such intricate runework... Done. The Wizard's Regalia is yours, pulsing with latent energy.

name: The Hall of Heroes
text: Beyond that iron door lies the Hall of Heroes — a proving ground where legends are forged or forgotten. I've seen a hundred warriors pass through it. Few earned the name. The door will open for any who carry the will to fight, but what waits inside... that's another matter. If you're half as capable as you look, I'd say go.

name: A Vial of Rage
text: I'm clean out of Elixir of Rage — that swirling red brew that smells of blood and sweat. Bring me a single vial and there's thirty gold in it for you. Keep the elixir; it's the gesture I'm paying for.
completionText: Ah — that lovely red shimmer. You're a darling. Here's the thirty gold I promised. Hold onto the vial; you'll want it before I will.

name: A Vial of Enlightenment
text: Could you spare an Elixir of Enlightenment? The blue one — smells faintly of ozone. A customer paid in advance and I've nothing on the shelf. Thirty gold for the favour, and you keep the vial.
completionText: Beautiful. That's the one. Thirty gold, as agreed — and the vial stays with you. You've saved me a very awkward conversation.

name: The Oracle's Marrow
text: Bring me a single vial of Starlight Nectar. It is liquid radiance, gathered only on the solstice and rarer than a dragon’s heart-blood. I know its resting place, but my bones are too brittle for the climb.Take this key; it will recognize the lock and part the stone for you. But heed my warning: the Vault is the private larder of Kargen the Cloud-Walker. He is a giant of the ancient peaks, and he has a short temper for thieves.
completionText: Look at that. Pure, cold starlight. It hasn't touched the earth in a thousand years. Kargen always did have a better eye for beauty than a giant deserves. Did he wake? No... don't tell me. If you're standing here, you were either silent or very, very lucky.

name: Life Essents
text: See that glow in your pack? That’s Life Essence. When you slay the monsters down there, their vital energy crystallizes. It’s the most versatile material in the world if you know how to handle it. Bring it to my forge, and I can weave it into your gear to make it stronger, sharper, and tougher.In here, essence is the only currency that truly matters
